verdict.rationale: BugSnag's official bugsnag-js SDK automatically detects errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa. Its docs cite error reporting libraries for over 50 platforms, including iOS and Android SDKs, and a hands-on community report confirms official iOS, Ruby, Node and Android libraries, with the iOS one auto-reporting fatal errors. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture on native Android and on non-Node backend SDKs, and recent independent hands-on corroboration (the community report is old).
